{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column more closely to understand the error
defects = df['revenue'].str.contains(r'\d\.\d{2}\d', na=False)
print(f'Number of entries with malformed revenue format: {defects.sum()}')

# Display a few examples of malformed revenue
malformed_examples = df[defects]['revenue'].head(10)
print('\nMalformed revenue examples:')
print(malformed_examples)"}
